card.name: Words leading into medical evaluations
card.fires_on: Small linking words or adjective endings just before a clinical evaluation or exam term, such as 'perform a' or 'dermat-ologic' before 'evaluation', 'ECG', or 'echocardiogram'. Also words just before cardiac or hospital record terms.

modes.label: Before an exam or evaluation
modes.description: A word or adjective ending right before 'evaluation' or a baseline test in a warnings section.
modes.example: Perform dermat<<ologic>> evaluations prior to initiation of TAFIN

modes.label: Before cardiac or hospital terms
modes.description: A linking word before heart-related or hospital-record words.
modes.example: In the setting of concomitant use of low-dose aspirin<< for>> cardiac prophylaxis, monitor patients more

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from 'care' words and toward unusual names or code-like strings, so no clear sense.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a named exam, test or record, like 'perform a' before an ECG.
